stationary_metric.definition: distance<=1m from current anchor, same native life, sample gap<=0.5s; moving loops not excluded

host_budget.scope: HOST aggregate non-idle delta including other workloads; interval averages not instantaneous peaks

limitations: 143 alive-observed lives plus3 initial no-alive-sampled positive spawn epochs; no assumption those3 never lived.
Live useful possession/current/fire_requested are separate; DoubleColt mask4 is excluded. No attributed hits/death causes.
Initial nonpositive epochs and same-loop inventory ordering are not first simulation-state proof.
Cecil events bounded to native observed life;1Hz states cannot prove uninterrupted watchdog freshness/authority.
The1m stationary metric does not detect moving goal/collision loops.
Actual reader is double-read, non-atomic; rejected torn probes and possible unobserved short lives remain.
No SWIM/DIVE or general teleport/MapReset qualification, no automatic map/release PASS.
No runtime/source changes by analyst; heavy analysis CPUQuota25%.
